text:
Positively great experience at Wish Dental Clinic…I’m am American from California and come to Thailand often for all sorts of (the right) reasons and happened to need some dental work done. I feel so fortunate to have found this clinic. Basically I needed new retainers and thought why not just have my teeth cleaned since they were almost due, therefore negating the same thing in the Bay Area with my usual (I.e. insurance plan) dentist who I never thought was actually truly good. Proceeded to absolutely get the best, most thorough, cleaning I’d ever had. The doctor (Dr. Mick, and hope the spelling’s correct) saw that restorations that were done several years ago were not in good condition which I sort of suspected because I could actually feel rough edges. This was not something my regular dentist back home even once mentioned and I’d seen her less than 9 months ago. Dr. (speaking English) explained exactly what was going on with my teeth and showed me with the X-rays they had just taken and with a mirror so I could see directly…and, or course what he could do (very honestly) to re-restore seven teeth needing work. Instinctively I completely trusted him and his professional expertise…one just knows that they are in totally capable hands. We scheduled the appointment, I went back and could not be happier…Dr. showed me the procedure step-by-step in a mirror as each tooth was being done and gave me a little education on dentistry that NO dentist had ever come close to doing…He’s a true professional that clearly enjoys practicing dentistry. Even though I reside in Palo Alto, California, my new dentist is here in Bangkok, Thailand…I see him again in November for another cleaning and check up. Hopes this helps with anyone’s search for awesome dental care.

Two days later I returned to Wish Dental Clinic to receive my new retainers. It was an another great visit…Dr. Mick tested the fit which was perfect and instructed me how to place them and take them out properly. He had me do it a couple of times to insure I did it right. He explained proper cleaning, storage and what could ruin them. I also got whitening gel which he also throughly explained the use of and how much whitening I should expect over how long. Again, I could have dreamed of receiving better dental care from Dr. Mick and his staff…I’ll wear the retainers tonight and if there are any issues (which I highly doubt) Dr. Mick wants to know so that they can be brought to the clinic and made perfect. Wish Dental Clinic is more than I could have ever wished for, and I feel super blessed to have found them!
